correspondences.notes: BIDS datatype (anat/dwi/func), label- and space- come from brainlife tags; 5TT masks are probseg.

brainlife.desc: Single binary or probabilistic NIfTI mask (mask.nii.gz), e.g. brain, white matter or 5TT; space and type are set by datatype tags.
brainlife.name: neuro/mask

original.readme: All mask data should have 2 datatype tags, one for the space and another one for mask type.

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Brain extraction, restricting model fits or tracking, and region selection.

**Not for:** Use in another space without resampling; check the space tag. Several regions; use neuro/rois or a parcellation.

**BIDS:** anat/mask (partial)

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 111 Apps, output of 61 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.mask.json

identifying_risks: Low; a brain mask shows head shape only coarsely
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level processed neurodata without direct identifiers.
tier_conditions: Tier 1 for template-space atlas masks with no participant data
